items.title: Tesla’s Electric Semi Could Win From High Diesel Prices
items.summary: Electric, autonomously driven big rigs are one solution to the shipping industry’s current diesel problem.  A gallon of diesel fuel is around $6, nearly double the year-ago level.  Crude oil prices aren’t up that much, but the fighting has taken so-called heavier crude off the market, which yields more diesel fuel per barrel, all else being equal.

items.title: FedEx launches Shopify app to combat surprise import charges
items.summary: FedEx Duty and Tax, part of the carrier's new suite of global shipping tools, provides a cost guarantee at checkout and covers any overages to that amount.

items.title: FedEx Enhances Global Trade With New Digital Shipping Tools
items.summary: FDX's Global Trade Navigator adds planning, cost, API and customs tools to make international shipping smoother and more transparent for businesses.

items.title: How Is FedEx’s Stock Performance Compared to Other Logistics Stocks
items.summary: FedEx has outperformed other supply chain logistics stocks over the past year. Analysts are also moderately bullish on the stock’s prospects.

items.title: JPMorgan starts FedEx Freight at Overweight on post-spin turnaround
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Tuesday, JPMorgan initiated coverage of FedEx Freight with an Overweight rating and a December 2027 price target of $160, arguing the recent spin-off gives North America's largest less-than-truckload carrier room to improve profitability and service as a stand-alone company.

items.title: FedEx (FDX) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After 78% Rally
items.summary: FedEx stock has rallied strongly over the past year, yet several valuation checks still point to room between the current share price and an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach. With both the DCF intrinsic value and market multiple checks suggesting the stock leans toward undervalued territory, investors are weighing how much of the recent optimism is already reflected in the price. items.title: FedEx (FDX) Faces New Lawsuit Over Truck Crash Allegations
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) is facing a new lawsuit after a major collision in which a company truck driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel, causing catastrophic injuries to the plaintiff. The complaint claims serious operational failures in FedEx's driver oversight and safety practices that, according to the filing, contributed to the crash.
